features.name: Make a list for a trip
features.match_note: A project tag gathers items; no trip list with entries of its own.

features.name: Delete a trip with its items
features.match_note: Deleting a tag, or a group with its items, is not defined.

features.name: See a trip as a photo grid
features.match_note: Photo browsing shows places by their photos; a tag's items as a grid is not defined.

features.name: Add an item with photo and note
features.match_note: Name, notes and an optional photo.

features.name: Rotate a photo
features.match_note: Automatic rotation is borrowed (R24); no manual rotate.

features.name: Save and add the next item
features.match_note: Quick add by name exists; no save-and-add-next.

features.name: Mark an item taken and brought back
features.match_note: The in use / away state covers out and back; no packing check per trip.

features.name: Sort trips and items, forgotten first
Get a reminder of what is missing
features.match_note: No departure reminders; the later rediscover prompt is not about missing things.

features.name: Delete an item or its photo
features.match_note: Deleting an item is mentioned only in passing; deleting a photo is not defined.

features.name: View a photo full screen
features.match_note: Item and place photos, and photo browsing.
